title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Vannathi confronts Pandian for prioritising his family over her feelings. Later, Chozhan is thrilled when Nila posts a status showcasing the gold bangles he gave her.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 62: VJS Unveils the Killer
description: VJS corners Muniyammal over task blunders and plays a shocking murder kurumpadam. After grilling detective Vasan, housemates vote, putting Muniyammal and Danya on the spot.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Shyam pressures Madhu over her father's loan and sends Arjun their selfie. Arjun rushes to the restaurant and grows anxious seeing Shyam drinking with Madhu.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani makes Vennila apologise to Mayuri after finding the misplaced money. At the expo, she sends Anbu away, saying she can manage herself.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: The family secretly decorates a room for Gomathi and Pandian's wedding-night surprise. Gomathi is stunned when she discovers their special arrangements.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sathya ignores Muthu and Meena's warnings about his changing attitude towards money. Meanwhile, Devika's auditor warns her of an impending income tax raid at her residence.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Hosts Makapa and Priyanka welcome special guest Rimi Tomy for a sensational episode. The stage lights up with stunning musical acts, special surprises, and a fun trip for all.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Prabhakaran tries to convince Divya to accept his love, but she firmly refuses him. Vethanayagam turns down Vetri's resignation request and asks him to continue working.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman credits Ilamathi as his lucky charm and teaches her to ride his bike. The public is amazed to see her riding with him behind, while Sidharth drinks over his defeat.
